title: Automatic Deposition of DAN Matrix using a TM Sprayer for MALDI Analysis of Lipids
author: Elizabeth Neumann
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bt8hnrt6
materials: Scan for autofluorescence on Zeiss Axio Scanner.
Open software and set nozzle temperature to 40 °C
Set method in software: 1350 mm/min nozzle velocity 1.5 mm track spacing 0.05 mL/min flow rate CC Pattern 2 L/min flow rate 5 passes 40mm nozzle height No drying time
Save method and make sure it is highlighted.
Change the HLPC flow rate to 0.05 mL/min.
Shut down the software and turn off the TM Sprayer.

steps.title: Prepare slides
steps.instruction: Remove slides from freezer and place in a desiccator for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Set sprayer nitrogen pressure
steps.instruction: Adjust nitrogen pressure to 6 psi and turn on the TM sprayer.

steps.title: Configure LC solvent line
steps.instruction: Set LC solvent line A1 to 100 % acetonitrile flowing at 0.05 mL min⁻¹.

steps.title: Initial sprayer injection
steps.instruction: Switch the sprayer to “Inject” mode and spray for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Load matrix solution
steps.instruction: Load 6 mL of matrix solution into the sprayer loop.

steps.title: Check matrix flow
steps.instruction: Switch to “Inject” mode and spray for ~1 minute, using a slide to confirm that matrix is flowing.

steps.title: Mount slide on heated block
steps.instruction: Tape the slide(s) onto a 75 °C heated block on the stage and adjust the software scanning area.

steps.title: Collect deposited slide
steps.instruction: When deposition is finished, remove the slide and place it in a slide box.

steps.title: Set sprayer cleaning temperature
steps.instruction: Set the TM sprayer temperature to 30 °C.

steps.title: Switch solvent to pure ACN
steps.instruction: Switch the A1 solvent line to 100 % acetonitrile and set the flow rate to 1 mL min⁻¹.

steps.title: Flush loop with acetonitrile
steps.instruction: Load the loop with 20 mL acetonitrile and inject for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Rinse nozzle tip
steps.instruction: Spray the nozzle tip with 5 mL of methanol (MEOH).

steps.title: Verify pressure after cleaning
steps.instruction: Log the pressure at the current flow rate; it must be within 3–4 psi of the starting pressure, otherwise repeat the cleaning procedure.

steps.title: Wipe stage
steps.instruction: Remove the foil and wipe the stage down with methanol.

steps.title: Dispose of syringes and waste
steps.instruction: Place all syringes in a biohazard container and empty the solvent waste.
